Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: The PATN (Digital Transformation Acceleration Project) launched January 2023 implements 57 projects for 2024 within the broader framework. Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: 'Vision Congo Digital 2025' strategy adopted, with e-government as pillar 2. The NDP 2022-2026 commits to digital economy as priority. Interoperability framework included in the multi-donor PATN project. No standalone comprehensive data exchange strategy; it is embedded within the broader digital strategy.
